item.title: ‘Trucking businesses cannot absorb these increased fuel costs’
item.description: The Australian Government is facing mounting pressure from the trucking industry to enact further measures, as skyrocketing diesel costs hit hard.

item.title: Government announces new support for truckies
item.description: The Australian Government has revealed it will amend the Fair Work Act to allow truckies and road transport businesses to make an emergency application for a contract chain order to deal with the current spike in fuel prices.

item.title: Truck driver charged over fatal Hume Highway crash
item.description: A truck driver has been charged with numerous offences following a fatal Hume Highway crash near Goulburn.

item.title: Truck drivers fight off would-be carjackers with a spirit level
item.description: Two truck drivers have fought off two thieves during an alleged car-jacking incident at a service station in the Melbourne suburb of Scoresby.

item.title: Surge in fuel thefts as prices reach record highs
item.description: Truck drivers are being urged be extra vigilant while parked, and service stations are being told to consider implementing pre-payment, with fuel thefts surging in recent weeks.

item.title: Warning to fuel levy flouters: truckies now have the law on their side
item.description: Under the existing system, operators faced a minimum six-month timeframe before any contract chain order could take effect.

item.title: Isuzu shines a light on technician pathways amid skills shortage
item.description: With skills shortages threatening productivity, fleet uptime and long-term industry sustainability, Isuzu Australia Limited (IAL) says technicians are the backbone of the industry.

item.title: Truckie's warning comes true as diesel surge hits hard
item.description: Experienced truck driver Adam Craig got it right when he warned this masthead that diesel prices approaching $3 per litre will force transport operators across Australia to park their trucks.

item.title: Truck driver killed in single vehicle crash near Lithgow
item.description: Emergency services were called to the Castlereagh Highway near Razorback Road, Ilford, around 60km north-west of Lithgow at around 12.10pm.

item.title: New chapter for industry in heavy vehicle accreditation
item.description: From mid-2026, the NHVAS will be replaced by the new HVA scheme as part of the 2025 Heavy Vehicle National Law amendments.
